# AstroArabia

> An Arabic-first, RTL-ready Astro theme for agencies, SaaS products, portfolios, documentation, landing pages, and blogs.

AstroArabia is a free and open-source static-first theme built with Astro and Tailwind CSS. It is designed for Arabic websites, uses native right-to-left layouts, and includes reusable components, dark mode, SEO metadata, and Markdown blog content.

## Links

- [Live demo](https://astroarabia.pages.dev/): Browse the complete deployed theme.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/almahers/astroarabia): Installation instructions, source code, and contribution guide.
- [Documentation demo](https://astroarabia.pages.dev/docs/): Technical documentation layout.
- [Agency demo](https://astroarabia.pages.dev/agency/): Agency and services layout.
- [SaaS demo](https://astroarabia.pages.dev/saas/): Product and SaaS layout.
- [Portfolio demo](https://astroarabia.pages.dev/portfolio/): Portfolio layout.
- [Landing page demo](https://astroarabia.pages.dev/landing/): Landing page layout.
- [Blog demo](https://astroarabia.pages.dev/blog/): Arabic Markdown blog layout.

## Usage

Use the source repository to install and customize the theme. The public demo is intended for browsing the available layouts and components.
